source_message.text:
Hi Jessica,

We liked your test submission, and we'd love to have you on board to help us update our Leadership Interview Questions You'll Most Likely Be Asked book!

To make sure we're aligned from the start, we wanted to walk you through the full scope of the project so you have a clear picture of what's ahead.

**Project Aim**

We're looking to update the first edition of the Leadership Interview Questions book so it reflects current industry standards and feels relevant to today's readers. As a quick-reference guide for interview preparation, this book is aimed at managers, team leads, and senior professionals with 4 to 5+ years of experience, as well as those stepping into leadership roles for the first time. We'd also like the book to offer a global perspective — showing how questions and answers can vary by country and industry.

**Project Stages**

**1\. Reviewing and updating existing content (Milestone 1)**
We'll share the first edition with you to review. As you go through the 250 questions, we'd love your input on which ones might be removed — whether because they feel outdated, don't quite connect with today's leadership landscape, or overlap with other questions in the book.

\--Streamlining the question set based on your review

\--Developing answers for the remaining content — worth noting, the answer layers we discussed (interviewer's intent, common mistakes, how to structure the answer, and answer framework) may not apply to every question. Once we've finalized the question set together, we can decide which ones need the full set of layers and which need just a couple.

**2\. Adding new chapters (Milestone 2)**
We're hoping to introduce a few new sections/chapters, and would love your thoughts on shaping them:

\--Pre-interview preparation checklist — since this audience already has experience, this chapter may need a leadership-specific angle rather than the basics. If there are tips especially relevant to leadership-level interviews, we'd love to include those.

\--Remote & Hybrid Leadership questions

\--Questions candidates can ask the interviewer

\--How to use AI for interview preparation (prompts, techniques, tools)

\--Questions specifically geared toward first-time leaders

Based on your response to the last briefing, you have highlighted which chapters seem the most relevant, and that's great! However, we are expecting all the chapters to be short only unless they include question & answer. The AI chapter seemed the most unique advantage that we could provide to the readers. In the current landscape, learning how to use AI for different purposes is important. So, that chapter has to be there.

**3\. Hybrid Experience (Milestone 3)**

\--All our books aim to offer readers a hybrid learning experience, since not everyone wants to read cover-to-cover. Alongside the book, we'd like to offer companion online resources — checklists, AI prompts, videos on body language, mock interviews, answer templates, leadership resume tips, or any other ideas you might have.

**A Note on Word Count**

As you work through the review and new additions, we'd appreciate you keeping an eye on the overall word count. Our books cap at 50K words, and the first edition sits around 37K — so on paper, that leaves roughly 13K words of room. That said, since we're revising the book fairly thoroughly and removing some questions along the way, we're hopeful that will free up additional space. Just wanted to flag that the final word count shouldn't go beyond 50K overall.

We've also attached our author guidelines for the Interview series — please take a look and let us know if anything needs more clarity. Link to author guidelines: <https://docs.google.com/document/d/1qd2L4HTm9ySBm41Z-XmrBeDS5Vga15Xyzpqwv0l2SIM/edit?usp=sharing>

Finally, here's the link to the full book in a Google Doc format. We're using the Google Doc version to track changes, though we're happy to share a PDF as well if that's easier for reference: <https://docs.google.com/document/d/1R_MeiYyX-mng1SXf25i6WdQpxfVEpyxILbL0NoaDbkw/edit?usp=sharing>

The actual working manuscript will be shared once we begin the project and make changes accordingly.

Looking forward to working on this together, Jessica — please don't hesitate to reach out with any questions! And if you would like to get on a call to clear your doubts, we can schedule a call accordingly.

value_updates.audience_focus: leadership-specific preparation for experienced candidates rather than basic interview preparation
value_updates.length_expectation: short unless presented as question-and-answer content

decisions.reason: The client’s all-chapters length rule applies to this new chapter; its question-and-answer format places it within the stated exception to the short-only expectation.
